about: The collect of the Third Sunday of Advent. It asks two things at once, a hearing and a light — not that circumstances change but that seeing does.

seg.tr: Incline Your ear, O Lord, we pray, to our prayers, and enlighten the darkness of our mind by the grace of Your visitation. You who live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

nt.w027: Deus can be nominative or vocative here: it can describe the One who lives and reigns as God, or address Him as “O God.” Both readings refer to Christ, whom the prayer addresses.
